faqs.q: What should I do if I have an issue with a motor vehicle dealer or repairer?
faqs.a: If you have an issue, you should follow the steps provided on the page.

faqs.q: What happens if I am unable to resolve my issue?
faqs.a: If you are unable to resolve your issue, NSW Fair Trading can assist.
